points.description: The answer conveys that the bridge table maps destination MAC addresses to outgoing LAN interfaces, and that the bridge fills it by reading the source address of each arriving frame and recording that address against the interface it arrived on (optionally with a timestamp). Equivalent wording earns the mark.

The answer conveys that a frame whose destination is in the table is forwarded only out the mapped interface instead of being flooded, and that this benefit is less duplication, less unnecessary flooding, less congestion, or better bandwidth use. Equivalent wording earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Total is 1 mark, so the scheme has two half-mark points: the table contents and backward learning, and the selective forwarding use with its benefit. Full marks need both ideas. Missing either idea earns no mark, since neither half is worth partial credit. Equivalent wording and alternative phrasings of the benefit are accepted.
